notes.title: Brand new brains for enemies!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32443835/6c486d4ea8683c87fcb0313eda43e7a4cc17fbc5.gif[/img]
Recently we've completely reworked AI for our enemies making them act more naturally and a bit smarter. Vehicles doesn't smash to each other with full speed and trying to avoid obstacles.

And now we have not only avoiding algorithms but also pathfinding one! Now you can't hide and must fight to death!
